about.en: 2U2.ai is an AI content-generation (AIGC) platform for producing and distributing community memes for Web3 projects, backed by the Japanese content studio DreamTech Co., Ltd. Its 2U2 token is the BEP-20 at 0xBa454dF19789372EEb1AB3b113A8F639594E31B9 on BNB Smart Chain, the contract named in KuCoin's listing announcement and used by Bitget, KuCoin and MEXC for deposits.
